# migadu_rewrite (Resource)

Manages a Migadu rewrite rule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "migadu_rewrite" "example" {
  domain_name     = "example.com"
  name            = "catch-support"
  local_part_rule = "support-*"
  destinations    = ["alice@example.com"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destinations` (List of String) List of destination addresses.
- `domain_name` (String) The domain this rewrite rule belongs to.
- `local_part_rule` (String) The local part rule pattern.
- `name` (String) The name (identifier) of the rewrite rule.

### Read-Only

- `order_num` (Number) The ordering number of the rule.
